jobs_results.title: UX/UI and Web Designer
jobs_results.description:
¡Hola!

Mi nombre es Julio y soy un diseñador web y UX/UI de 30 años con experiencia en programación en HTML, CSS, Javascript y Wordpress. He podido especializarme también en UX/UI para profundizar en las metodologías de diseño y análisis más rigurosas, además de adquirir una amplia destreza con la herramienta Figma.

Junto con ello, he trabajado durante más de 4 años en el mundo audiovisual para los medios de comunicación más importantes de España como editor de vídeo, lo que me ha ayudado a desarrollar una gran habilidad en la construcción de narrativas eficaces que ahora estoy pudiendo aplicar en mis diseños para web y apps.

Soy una persona aplicada, acostumbrada a trabajar en equipo y en un entorno donde cada día es una nueva aventura. Si buscas a un diseñador resolutivo, apasionado y de gran calidad humana, estaría encantado de incorporarme a tu equipo. ¡Quedo a la espera!

jobs_results.title: Frontend developer with UI/UX skills
jobs_results.description:
About us:

We are an AI-Powered Sales Engagement & Lead Intelligence SaaS that helps B2B companies grow. We launched only one year ago and already have companies using the tool to grow their business and get more leads. Our company is considered to be one of the fastest-growing bootstrapped startups in Europe.

Why we need you:

As our development team continues to expand, we are looking for a skilled Frontend Developer with strong UI/UX skills to focus on frontend tasks. With the increasing complexity of our projects, we need someone who can bring expertise and precision to our frontend development processes.

• Collaborate with the engineering team to ensure integration of frontend components.
• Participate in UI/UX discussions and provide valuable insights for enhancing user experience.
• Take ownership of frontend tasks and deliver solutions within specified timelines. Requirements:
• Proficiency in is... required; experience with is optional but desirable.

• Fluent in English for daily conversations and team interactions.
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies.
• Experience working with UI/UX design tools such as Figma or Sketch. Company perks
• Opportunity to work with a rapidly growing SaaS company in a dynamic industry;
• Chance to work with a talented and passionate team of professionals;
• Competitive salary and benefits package;
• Opportunity for career growth and advancement;
• Casual and dynamic work environment;
• Opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the success of our platform

jobs_results.title: Data Designer (UX/UI)
jobs_results.description:
EXCELLENT LONG TERM FULLY REMOTE FREELANCE OPPORTUNITY FOR A DATA DESIGNER (UX/UI) DEVELOPER TO JOIN A MASSIVE GLOBAL INSURANCE ENTERPRISE ON A HUGE GREENFIELD PROJECT!!

Responsibilities:
• Lead the design process from concept to delivery, including conducting user research, and creating wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
• Collaborate with product managers and engineers to define product requirements and prioritize design solutions based on user needs and business goals.
• Conduct user testing and gather feedback to iterate on designs and improve the overall user experience.
• Maintain and evolve our design system to ensure consistency and scalability across all digital products.
• Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in UX/UI design, and advocate for innovative design solutions within the organization.
• Mentor junior designers and contribute to the overall growth and development of the design team.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Design... HCI, or related field.
• 6+ years of experience in UX/UI design with a strong portfolio showcasing your design process and completed projects.
• Knowledge in Data Design Or data viz
• Proficiency in design tools such as Figma,.
• Experience with prototyping tools.
• Strong understanding of user-centred design principles and best practices.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate and defend design decisions.
• Experience working in agile development environments and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment, with a passion for solving complex design challenges.
• Fluent ENGLISH.

Rate: Up to €300/day

Location: Fully Remote

Contract Length: 6-12 Months + Extension (FIVE YEAR PROJECT)

Start Date: Immediate

Please reach out to miles.girling@exploreltd.com to find out more

jobs_results.title: Senior UX Designer
jobs_results.description:
Senior UX Designer

Why this role matters

As a Senior UX Designer at Vonage, you will play a strategic role across all stages of the design process, from understanding business strategy and brand, customer needs and market context, formulating outcome-oriented hypotheses and concepts, creating prototypes, validation and measurement, interaction & visual design, feature delivery and optimisation.

At Vonage, our UX Designers play a pivotal role in ensuring that the products and features brought to market are crafted to the highest standard, drive value, and meet and balance the needs of the people who use them and our business vision and goals.

As a Senior you will be responsible for guiding team members, Product Managers, Engineering and stakeholders through the end-to-end design process, inspiring and motivating buy-in and ensuring that decisions along the way are informed by the right insights that will deliver maximum value.

IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU, CONTINUE READING... BELOW.......

What you will do
• Lead knowledge gathering exercises, such as the planning and facilitation of stakeholder workshops, business interviews, market analysis, design and customer research activities
• Guide teams through crafting high-level visions for products and services, working with PMs to understand business and customer needs and collaborating in the creation of customer outcomes that drive human behavioural change with our products and services.
• Oversee the validation of hypothesis, propositions and concepts, through user feedback and measurable testing activities
• Support our product teams in translating high-level strategic visions of service and products into a delivery focussed roadmap - leading iterative prioritisation and concepting activities, and informing what should be made and why
• Oversee deliverables including prototypes, proof of concept documents, wire frames, elegant user flows, experience maps, etc
• Understand requirements and where appropriate, challenge the approach, backed up with sound customer, business and market insight and data
• Collaborate closely with Product managers, Engineering and Design team members to deliver validated Human Centred Design Solutions throughout the entire design process from discovery through to delivery and beyond.
• Contribute to and help evolve our design system, and individually contribute to an array of projects that use our design system.
• Work closely with remote international teams.

What you will bring
• Proven and practical experience guiding and leading product teams/squads in the definition and delivery of user-centred products and services end-to-end, from unvalidated propositions and concepts through to delivery into market, across a variety of projects types - from strategic initiatives to optimisation of existing projects and quick wins
• Experience of working on projects you have led in the real-world which combine user-centred design principles together with a lean-Agile delivery methodology
• Led co-creation, research and testing activities
• Formed close relationships and earned trust with stakeholders
• Established best practices and refined ways of working.
• Provide context and coaching for other team members in ways of working, processes and practices
• Guiding and mentoring members of your team to support their individual progression in Decision Making and Accountability, Planning & Organisational skills, Coaching and Peer Development

What is required for application
• Highly skilled in in relevant UX, CX and UI (Figma) software tools and able to contribute to and utilise Design Systems
• Ability to cultivate an environment of ego-less teamwork and cooperation, and build partnerships across the organisation to enhance and drive the value of design and UX.
• Ability to demonstrate experience and ownership of the entire design process from problem understanding, defining customer outcomes, concepting, final delivery and ongoing iteration.
(Case studies are recommended)
• Ability to articulate and advocate for UX and CX principles, strategy, and theory with designers, engineers, product managers, and executives through writing, visuals, and presentations.
• Flexible and comfortable with ambiguity and change during a project
• Extensive UX design experience
• Portfolio with case studies of shipped work demonstrating impactful UX design leadership and exemplary understanding of user-centred design principles.
• Experience working in a collaborative team, partnering closely with product management to define use cases and requirements, and working directly with developers on implementation of your designs.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills including the ability to communicate design concepts clearly and persuasively across different audiences and varying levels of the organisation.
• Proven ability to both deliver a bold vision and iterate quickly on concepts to arrive at an amazing customer experience.
• Fluency in information architecture, as well as solid knowledge of usability principles and techniques.
• Bachelor's degree in UX design, interaction design,
or equivalent professional experience.
• Proficiency in a variety of design tools such as Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, Flinto.
• Experience designing large-scale systems and applications
• Experience in user research methodologies.
• Affinity for and experience in building interactive prototypes.

Preferred Qualifications
• Extensive UX design experience
• An available portfolio
• Extraordinary portfolio with case studies of shipped work demonstrating impactful UX design leadership and exemplary understanding of user-centred design principles.
• Experience working in a collaborative team, partnering closely with product management to define use cases and requirements, and working directly with developers on implementation of your designs.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills including the ability to communicate design concepts clearly and persuasively across different audiences and varying levels of the organisation.
• Passion for learning and innovation, balanced with business needs and customer expectations.
• Self-motivated, able to work both independently and collaboratively within a team as projects need.
• Proven ability to both deliver a bold vision and iterate quickly on concepts to arrive at an amazing customer experience.
• Fluency in information architecture, as well as solid knowledge of usability principles and techniques.
• Experience developing UX across different types of devices and screen sizes.
• Bachelor's degree in UX design, interaction design, or equivalent professional experience.
• Proficiency in a variety of design tools such as Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, Flinto.
• Experience designing large-scale systems and applications
• Experience in user research methodologies.
• Strong bias for action including the ability to juggle multiple priorities and effectively deliver in a fast paced, dynamic environment
• Affinity for and experience in building interactive prototypes.
• Passion for the role of design within an organisation and the ability to develop and mentor design talent

What's in it for you
• A highly visible role on a flagship product whose success is core to the company's strategy.
• In addition to providing exciting work, career advancement opportunities, and a collaborative work environment, Vonage provides competitive pay and benefits, including unlimited discretionary time off and tuition reimbursement.

#LI-MB2

#LI-REMOTE

Queremos incorporar al equipo Dinamic un experto en diseño digital 2D y 3D apasionado por la creación de videojuegos, el marketing digital y el diseño de interface.
Requisitos mínimos

1. Dominio de Photoshop
2. Dominio de 3DS Max (o aplicación equivalente)
3. Portfolio de trabajos realizados
Requisitos deseados

1. Habilidad con el dibujo a mano alzada.
2. Experiencia en diseño HTML5 / CCS3.
3. Experiencia en formatos RRSS.
4. Experiencia con aplicaciones de imagen AI.
Responsabilidades

1. Será el responsable del diseño de arte de los nuevos videojuegos Dinamic para su aplicación a la Web y al Marketing digital.
2. Asumirá la creación y el mantenimiento del Interface de usuario de FX+, nuestra nueva plataforma de descarga y streaming de videojuegos.
Beneficios

1. Proyecto internacional
2. Horario y jornada flexible de mañana y/o tarde
3. Teletrabajo (90%)
4. Compatible con otras actividades laborales o profesionales.
5. Retribución por hora a acordar con el candidato.

En ALTEN tenemos claro que el éxito de nuestros proyectos se debe a las personas que forman nuestro equipo. Por eso, si tienes más de 5 años con experiencia como UX/UI nos comprometemos a impulsar tu talento, satisfacer tus expectativas laborales y hacerte sentir como en casa. ¿Te unes a nuestro #WelcomeHome? ¡Sigue leyendo!

¿Qué buscamos?

- Experiencia de más de 5 años con UX/UI

- Experiencia principalmente con herramienta FIGMA

- Conocimientos/experiencia con Research, prototipado y testing

- Scrum

- Inglés fluido

¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?

- Contrato indefinido y estabilidad.

Somos un equipo. Formamos parte de ALTEN, una... multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español.

Si te gustan las cifras, te diremos que tenemos una facturación mundial de más de 3.650 millones de euros, contamos con 52.700 profesionales y estamos presentes en más de 30 países.

Además, en ALTEN nos enorgullecemos de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades con independencia de género, edad, diversidad de capacidades o país de origen. Nuestro compromiso está con el talento y con las personas que lo tienen.

jobs_results.title: Experience Designer
jobs_results.description:
EA SPORTS Madden NFL is the best-selling sports property in U.S. video game history. Madden NFL is an immersive, simulation-based, authentic NFL interactive experience that empowers fans to play out their NFL fantasies. Madden NFL has entertained fans for over three decades with more than 130 million lifetime units sold.

Madden NFL is developed by EA's Tiburon Studio in Orlando, FL, and Madrid, Spain. The team prides itself on innovation and creative collaboration. We're looking for talent with a passion for sports to create experiences that connect with football fans around the world to grow the love of the sport.

We looking for a Technical Experience Designer who is passionate about solving complex problems and building experiences to delight our players

Your Responsibilities
• The Technical Experience Designer bridges the gap between artists and software engineers.
• Work with the UI team (Artist, Engineers, Designers) to solve problems, refine workflows, and polish the UI to... create an outstanding user experience, from concept to implementation.
• Create and implement UI screens, widgets, script animations and effects for game front-end and HUD.
• Recreation of authentic broadcast overlays and in game overlays to match styles: Create state-of-the-art in-game content, with a goal of organization, reusability and with the thought of developing for a live product (easily updatable)
• Break-down features into defined structures, components, and processes that meet the technical, aesthetic, and functional requirements of the game's vision
• High fidelity rapid prototyping for UX evaluation
• Stay up-to-date on changes in technology, regarding hardware, art packages, and new asset creation techniques
• Investigate new techniques and implement them within the game.
• Advocate for user experience, product consistency, and design excellence.
• You will report into the Development Director of the team you'll be part of.

Your Qualifications
• Experience prototyping, developing and maintaining UI features from concept to release.
• Experience with scripting languages (C#, Actionscript...), visual scripting or other Object Oriented programming languages.
• Good knowledge of Photoshop and other applications from Adobe suite (After Effects, Adobe XD)
• Experience with UI/UX implementation in game engines desired, such as Unity or Unreal.
• Strong technical skills, and ability to quickly learn new proprietary production tools and workflow
• Strong attention to detail in both visual animation and programming
• Excellent problem solving skills: a successful candidate must be able to quickly identify and debug issues.
• Ability to communicate clearly with both engineering and art, articulating both the needs of the art team and the constraints of tech.
• Must be able to document all tools on the internal wiki and support artists on the use of new tools.

Additional Qualifications
• A portfolio that showcases relevant work that contains well thought out process and excellent craft execution, in the areas of UI/UX technical design (motion graphics and game development is a plus.
• Good understanding of UX methodology, and Design theory.
• Understanding of revision version control software. Knowledge of Perforce is ideal.
